title: DealLedger: an open record of US businesses listed for sale
description: Daily-verified snapshot of business-for-sale listings published directly on US business brokers' own websites, with first-observed dates, listing-age evidence basis, asking-price changes and listings that left observation. Collected by DealLedger (https://dealledger.org). Public domain (CC0 1.0). Field definitions in DATA_DICTIONARY.md.
